author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to install and use Ollama on Windows to run AI models locally for free. In this beginner tutorial, we'll set up Ollama without an account, choose a local model, chat with AI, ask follow-up questions, and analyze a PDF on your computer. Then we'll connect Ollama to OpenCode and build a website with AI that creates files directly on your PC. Once you've downloaded a local model, you can use it offline. Cloud models are optional and work differently; this tutorial focuses on local AI.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Ollama: https://ollama.com/
- Download Ollama for Windows: https://ollama.com/download/windows
- OpenCode: https://opencode.ai/
- Download OpenCode: https://opencode.ai/download

⌚ TIMESTAMPS
0:00 - Introduction
0:28 - Download and install Ollama on Windows
1:49 - Choose a local AI model
2:41 - Run your first prompt and ask follow-up questions
3:24 - Chat history and new conversations
3:44 - Analyze a PDF locally
4:33 - Install OpenCode and connect Ollama
5:21
title: How to Use Ollama (Free Local AI)
